facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 75°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 5 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 30.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 16 to 26 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Black Springs
evidence.detail: left May 2; earlier seasons: June 17 (2023), May 28 (2024), May 8 (2025)

evidence.name: Blue Lakes
evidence.detail: left May 14; earlier seasons: July 5 (2023), June 1 (2024), May 23 (2025)

evidence.name: Ebbetts Pass
evidence.detail: left May 9; earlier seasons: June 29 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 18 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Black Springs
evidence.detail: 3.6 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 69.6 in (2023), 31.9 in (2024), 7.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Blue Lakes
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 74.4 in (2023), 34.0 in (2024), 26.0 in (2025)

evidence.name: Ebbetts Pass
evidence.detail: 6.7 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 77.6 in (2023), 35.3 in (2024), 28.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 11 and June 7, carried from the melt-out dates at 4 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Black Springs
evidence.detail: melted out May 2, 915 ft below the pass; points to April 20 to June 15

evidence.name: Blue Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out May 14, 645 ft above the pass; points to April 6 to May 29

evidence.name: Ebbetts Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 9, 1,245 ft above the pass; points to March 17 to May 18

evidence.name: Lost Lakes
